messages.subject: Sustainability governance and stakeholder execution | Yara value proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stormyr,

I am reaching out because Yara's sustainability governance agenda sits close to the work I lead today: turning external commitments, regulatory expectations and operating evidence into accountable management action.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My country-facing mandate spans ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance, stakeholder strategy and executive coordination. I also support renewable-energy stakeholder alignment and carbon-data traceability in a large industrial operating environment.

I prepared the attached executive value brief around areas where this experience may support Yara: sustainability governance, evidence and assurance readiness, stakeholder accountability, responsible industrial transition and cross-functional execution. The final three pages contain my executive CV.

My interest is broader than a reporting-only ESG role. I am strongest where sustainability, regulation, external affairs and operating delivery meet. I would value a short discussion on whether this profile fits a current or emerging Director, Head, international sustainability, external-affairs or strategic mandate within Yara. I am based in Guyana, open to relocation, and would require employer-supported Norwegian work authorization.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal for Yara Sustainability Governance
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Yara is combining industrial competitiveness, capital discipline and profitable decarbonisation while operating across more than 60 countries and complex regulatory environments. My proposition is to contribute at the point where sustainability governance must connect with operating evidence, public institutions, stakeholder expectations and executive accountability. I lead ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance and cross-functional stakeholder execution for a major mining operation within Zijin Mining Group. My experience includes renewable-energy stakeholder alignment, carbon-data traceability, regulator-facing coordination and disciplined follow-through on commitments, giving me an operator-grounded perspective relevant to Yara's sustainability and responsible-growth agenda.
strategic_brief.company_context: Yara's 2026 strategy places resilient earnings, capital productivity and sustainable growth alongside continued industrial decarbonisation. Its 2025 reporting is aligned with European Sustainability Reporting Standards, while the company is advancing large industrial initiatives such as carbon capture at Sluiskil and low-emission ammonia pathways. This means sustainability governance must remain credible to investors and regulators while also helping operating teams manage evidence, risks, targets and stakeholder expectations. Yara's global footprint adds further complexity because regulatory regimes, public-sector expectations and social contexts differ materially by market. Strong governance therefore depends on clear ownership, reliable source data, cross-functional alignment and practical links between corporate commitments and operating decisions.

opportunities.title: Evidence-led sustainability governance
opportunities.rationale: ESRS-aligned reporting and major decarbonisation investments increase the importance of reliable source data, clear control ownership and defensible evidence. Sustainability governance creates greater business value when reporting requirements are connected directly to the people, systems and operating decisions generating the underlying performance.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I coordinated a carbon-data proof of concept built around physical operating records, source ownership and traceability across a complex industrial asset. I would bring the same evidence discipline to sustainability controls, management reporting, assurance preparation and issue follow-through.

opportunities.title: Stakeholder accountability across regulated markets
opportunities.rationale: Yara's industrial assets and transition investments depend on regulators, governments, communities, customers and strategic partners. These relationships influence approvals, operating continuity, investment conditions and trust, especially where environmental and climate expectations are changing quickly.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: My current mandate includes senior engagement with ministries, regulators and public institutions across mining, environment, energy, labour, standards and investment. I would support structured stakeholder mapping, engagement strategy, executive briefing and accountable follow-through in priority international contexts.

opportunities.title: Responsible industrial transition execution
opportunities.rationale: Projects such as large-scale carbon capture and low-emission ammonia require sustainability claims to remain aligned with operational performance, commercial viability, regulatory requirements and stakeholder expectations. Strong cross-functional governance helps management detect gaps early and maintain credibility as projects move from ambition into execution.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I work at the interface of industrial operations, ESG and external institutions, including stakeholder alignment around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage. I would bring practical experience connecting transition initiatives with governance, evidence and external positioning.

opportunities.title: Executive issue management and cross-functional delivery
opportunities.rationale: Material sustainability matters often span operations, HSE, environment, legal, finance, procurement, HR and communications. Without clear ownership and escalation, the organisation risks inconsistent responses, weak documentation and delayed closure of regulatory or stakeholder commitments.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I coordinate high-priority issues across these functions, translating external requirements into executive briefs, action owners, evidence requirements and deadlines. This operating model would support sustainability governance where speed, consistency and documented accountability matter.

days_0_30: Map priority sustainability-governance interfaces, data owners, external stakeholders and current assurance dependencies.
Review selected material topics to identify gaps between commitments, source evidence, management controls and operating ownership.
Identify international markets or assets where government and stakeholder complexity creates the greatest governance risk or opportunity.
days_31_60: Build a concise governance dashboard linking material issues to owners, evidence, deadlines and executive escalation paths.
Strengthen stakeholder plans for priority regulatory, public-sector and sustainability matters.
Develop practical templates connecting sustainability commitments with operating data and management actions.
days_61_90: Support selected assurance, reporting or stakeholder workstreams with evidence-based follow-through.
Close priority governance gaps through coordinated action across operations and corporate functions.
Introduce repeatable routines for issue escalation, source traceability and executive decision support.
days_91_180: Scale effective governance practices across additional topics, assets or international markets.
Measure improvements in evidence readiness, issue closure, stakeholder response quality and management visibility.
Support strategic sustainability and responsible-growth initiatives where regulatory and institutional alignment affects execution.

potential_impact: Stronger audit and assurance readiness through clearer data ownership, source traceability and documented controls.
Faster closure of material sustainability and stakeholder issues through explicit ownership and escalation.
Better integration of regulatory, external-affairs and operating perspectives into sustainability governance.
Additional international execution capacity for decarbonisation, responsible growth and stakeholder-sensitive industrial projects.
background_relevance: Director-level leadership across ESG, social responsibility, government relations, corporate affairs and regulatory coordination in a major multinational mining operation.
Carbon-data assurance experience covering a 52.6 million-litre fuel baseline, 34 entities, 408 monthly entries and 592 equipment IDs, with emphasis on source ownership and traceability.
Energy-transition stakeholder exposure around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.
Cross-functional coordination across environment, HSE, legal, finance, operations, procurement, HR, security and executive leadership on high-scrutiny external matters.
